author: Sideprojects
description:
From mechanical computers to video calling, many technologies we consider modern were actually invented decades earlier. Charles Babbage designed a programmable computer in 1837, fax machines existed in the 1840s, and AT&T launched video phones in 1964. This episode explores why these revolutionary inventions failed to catch on for generations.
